data.one_liner: A horizontal data table with a fixed column on the left-hand side.
data.what_it_does: Creates a horizontal data table widget that supports a fixed first column (or right-side column in RTL mode), fixed headers and footers, scroll synchronization, and optional pull-to-refresh/load features.
use_when: You need to display tabular data with a locked/fixed first column while scrolling horizontally.
You require fixed headers or footers alongside a scrollable grid of data.
You need built-in pull-to-refresh or pull-to-load functionality within a horizontal table.
avoid_when: You only need a basic vertical-only list or standard Flutter DataTable without horizontal fixed columns.
You require complex spreadsheet-like editing features built-in out of the box.
strengths: Provides fixed left/right column capability with synchronized scrolling.
Supports pull-to-refresh and pull-to-load new data features.
Allows both index-based builders or direct lists of child widgets.
weaknesses: Pull-to-refresh implementation requires matching indicator widgets and specific controllers to synchronize properly.
Customizing scroll physics can sometimes conflict with built-in refresh actions.
data.minimal_example:
HorizontalDataTable(
  leftHandSideColumnWidth: 100,
  rightHandSideColumnWidth: 600,
  isFixedHeader: true,
  headerWidgets: _getTitleWidget(),
  leftSideItemBuilder: _generateFirstColumnRow,
  rightSideItemBuilder: _generateRightHandSideColumnRow,
  itemCount: widget.user.userInfo.length,
)
